description: Add, change, hide or remove layer style effects (Layer > Layer Style), as the Layer Style dialog does. effects maps each effect to an options object (omitted options keep the current settings, or Photoshop's defaults for a new effect), true (add or keep with defaults), false (delete the effect), or for dropShadow, innerShadow, colorOverlay, gradientOverlay and stroke a list (several instances, each from defaults). enabled: false hides one effect. Options by effect: dropShadow (enabled, blendMode, color, opacity, angle, useGlobalLight, distance, spread, size, contour, antiAlias, noise, knocksOut); innerShadow (enabled, blendMode, color, opacity, angle, useGlobalLight, distance, choke, size, contour, antiAlias, noise); outerGlow (enabled, blendMode, color, opacity, noise, technique, spread, size, contour, antiAlias, range, jitter); innerGlow (enabled, blendMode, color, opacity, noise, technique, choke, size, contour, antiAlias, range, jitter, source); bevelEmboss (enabled, style, technique, depth, direction, size, soften, angle, altitude, useGlobalLight, glossContour, glossAntiAlias, highlightMode, highlightColor, highlightOpacity, shadowMode, shadowColor, shadowOpacity, contour, texture); satin (enabled, blendMode, color, opacity, angle, distance, size, contour, antiAlias, invert); colorOverlay (enabled, blendMode, color, opacity); gradientOverlay (enabled, blendMode, opacity, gradient, style, angle, reverse, dither, alignWithLayer, scale); patternOverlay (enabled, blendMode, opacity, pattern, scale, linkWithLayer); stroke (enabled, size, position, blendMode, opacity, overprint, fill, color, gradient, gradientStyle, angle, pattern, scale). Sizes are pixels, opacities percent, angles degrees

effects.description: For example { dropShadow: { distance: 8, size: 12 }, stroke: { size: 2, color: "#FFFFFF" }, outerGlow: false }

bevelEmboss.description: Options: enabled, style, technique, depth, direction, size, soften, angle, altitude, useGlobalLight, glossContour, glossAntiAlias, highlightMode, highlightColor, highlightOpacity, shadowMode, shadowColor, shadowOpacity, contour, texture

colorOverlay.description: Options: enabled, blendMode, color, opacity, instance (0-based, which one to change)

dropShadow.description: Options: enabled, blendMode, color, opacity, angle, useGlobalLight, distance, spread, size, contour, antiAlias, noise, knocksOut, instance (0-based, which one to change)

gradientOverlay.description: Options: enabled, blendMode, opacity, gradient, style, angle, reverse, dither, alignWithLayer, scale, instance (0-based, which one to change)

innerGlow.description: Options: enabled, blendMode, color, opacity, noise, technique, choke, size, contour, antiAlias, range, jitter, source

innerShadow.description: Options: enabled, blendMode, color, opacity, angle, useGlobalLight, distance, choke, size, contour, antiAlias, noise, instance (0-based, which one to change)

outerGlow.description: Options: enabled, blendMode, color, opacity, noise, technique, spread, size, contour, antiAlias, range, jitter

patternOverlay.description: Options: enabled, blendMode, opacity, pattern, scale, linkWithLayer

satin.description: Options: enabled, blendMode, color, opacity, angle, distance, size, contour, antiAlias, invert

stroke.description: Options: enabled, size, position, blendMode, opacity, overprint, fill, color, gradient, gradientStyle, angle, pattern, scale, instance (0-based, which one to change)

replace.description: Start from an empty style, dropping effects not given

target.description: Which layers to act on. Give ids (from list_layers or a create tool), names, or active: true. Default the active layer

names.description: Layer names (every layer with each name)

name: set_layer_effects
title: Set Layer Effects
